📊 Metrics API

Time-series metrics ingestion and aggregation with OpenTelemetry protocol

Base URL

{{.BaseURL}}/v1/metrics

Endpoints

POST /v1/metrics

Ingest metrics using OpenTelemetry protocol

Headers

Content-Type: application/x-protobuf
Authorization: Bearer <api-key>

Request Body

OpenTelemetry ExportMetricsServiceRequest protobuf message

{
  "resource_metrics": [{
    "resource": {
      "attributes": [
        {"key": "service.name", "value": {"string_value": "my-service"}},
        {"key": "service.version", "value": {"string_value": "1.0.0"}}
      ]
    },
    "scope_metrics": [{
      "scope": {
        "name": "my-meter",
        "version": "1.0.0"
      },
      "metrics": [{
        "name": "http_requests_total",
        "description": "Total number of HTTP requests",
        "unit": "1",
        "sum": {
          "data_points": [{
            "attributes": [
              {"key": "method", "value": {"string_value": "GET"}},
              {"key": "status", "value": {"string_value": "200"}}
            ],
            "start_time_unix_nano": "1640995200000000000",
            "time_unix_nano": "1640995260000000000",
            "as_int": "42"
          }],
          "aggregation_temporality": "AGGREGATION_TEMPORALITY_CUMULATIVE",
          "is_monotonic": true
        }
      }, {
        "name": "http_request_duration_seconds",
        "description": "HTTP request duration in seconds",
        "unit": "s",
        "histogram": {
          "data_points": [{
            "attributes": [
              {"key": "method", "value": {"string_value": "GET"}}
            ],
            "start_time_unix_nano": "1640995200000000000",
            "time_unix_nano": "1640995260000000000",
            "count": "100",
            "sum": 15.5,
            "bucket_counts": ["10", "20", "30", "25", "10", "5"],
            "explicit_bounds": [0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.5, 5.0, 10.0]
          }],
          "aggregation_temporality": "AGGREGATION_TEMPORALITY_CUMULATIVE"
        }
      }]
    }]
  }]
}

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "partial_success": {
    "rejected_data_points": 0,
    "error_message": ""
  }
}

GET /v1/metrics/query

Query time-series metrics with PromQL-like syntax

Query Parameters

  • query - Metric query expression
  • start - Start time (Unix timestamp or RFC3339)
  • end - End time (Unix timestamp or RFC3339)
  • step - Query resolution step (e.g., "5m", "1h")

Example Query

GET /v1/metrics/query?query=http_requests_total{method="GET"}&start=1640995200&end=1640998800&step=60

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "resultType": "matrix",
    "result": [{
      "metric": {
        "__name__": "http_requests_total",
        "method": "GET",
        "service": "my-service"
      },
      "values": [
        [1640995200, "100"],
        [1640995260, "110"],
        [1640995320, "125"]
      ]
    }]
  }
}

GET /v1/metrics/query_range

Query metrics over a time range with aggregation

Query Parameters

  • query - Metric query with aggregation functions
  • start - Start time
  • end - End time
  • step - Aggregation step

Supported Functions

  • rate() - Calculate per-second rate
  • sum() - Sum values across dimensions
  • avg() - Average values
  • max() - Maximum value
  • min() - Minimum value
  • histogram_quantile() - Calculate percentiles

Example

GET /v1/metrics/query_range?query=rate(http_requests_total[5m])&start=1640995200&end=1640998800&step=300

GET /v1/metrics/labels

List available metric labels

Query Parameters

  • match[] - Label matcher expressions
  • start - Start time (optional)
  • end - End time (optional)

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "success",
  "data": [
    "__name__",
    "method",
    "service",
    "status"
  ]
}

GET /v1/metrics/label/{label_name}/values

Get all values for a specific label

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "success",
  "data": [
    "GET",
    "POST",
    "PUT",
    "DELETE"
  ]
}

Metric Types

Counter

Monotonically increasing values (e.g., request count)

Gauge

Current values that can go up or down (e.g., CPU usage)

Histogram

Distribution of values in configurable buckets (e.g., response time)

Summary

Quantile observations over sliding time windows

Rate Limits

  • Ingestion: 100,000 data points/second per API key
  • Query: 1,000 requests/minute per API key
  • Batch size: Maximum 10,000 data points per request
  • Query complexity: Maximum 10,000 series per query
